title: Monochromatic reachability in arc-colored digraphs
exact_target: Can a bounded number of stable sets, depending only on the number of arc colours, receive a monochromatic directed path from every vertex of any finite digraph?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3275 (OPG-60028). CC BY 4.0.
